screenText: dors inventory_2 Inventory receipt_long Invoices Invoices Import Preview cloud_upload Select CSV File cloud_download Download Template Import Invoices To do a invoices import you need to have a csv file with following columns: Shop Location, Customer, VIN, Year, Make, Model, Unit #, Unit Type, Mileage, Hours, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, PO, Service Advisor, Item, Line Title - What are you doing, Line Description - Why are you doing it, Tech Story, Part #, Part Description, Qty, Rate, Total, Tax Amount. Your file's first row must contain these columns. Also, new line separator is used for new row, comma for columns.
